summary: Frontend-only localization regression test was partially completed on mobile web preview. Verified: admin login works, Settings opens, and language options are limited to exactly tr-TR and en-US. Turkish Settings + legal link labels render correctly. Full scenario completion (empty Explore flow in both languages, persistence, full login/register bilingual pass) was blocked by tab selector mismatch in bottom navigation.

ui_bugs.issue: Explore tab testID is localized as 'tab-kesfet' instead of stable/neutral naming (e.g. tab-explore). This caused repeated selector failures during bilingual regression flow automation and blocks robust cross-language UI tests.

integration_issues.flow: Settings -> Explore (TR/EN empty feed checks) -> persistence/login-register bilingual checks
integration_issues.issue: Could not complete end-to-end due to missing expected stable Explore tab selector in runtime path used by test automation.

action_items: Standardize Explore tab testID to language-agnostic naming (recommended: tab-explore) in /app/frontend/src/components/custom-tab-bar.tsx.

Re-run localization suite after selector stabilization to complete pending checks: TR<->EN switching over empty Explore flow, EN persistence after reload, and login/register bilingual text verification.
Keep language selector strictness as-is (SUPPORTED_LANGS is correctly limited to tr-TR and en-US).
critical_code_review_comments: Language picker implementation is correct: /app/frontend/src/i18n.tsx defines SUPPORTED_LANGS=["tr-TR","en-US"] and Settings renders from this array, so only two options are user-facing.
Language persistence path is implemented via secure storage key 'swipedia.lang' and normalizeLang() in /app/frontend/src/i18n.tsx; functional retest is still required due the navigation test blocker.
No obvious British spelling residues were found by static grep in frontend source for common UK spellings (colour/favourite/organise/centre/behaviour).

success_rate.frontend: 40% (core checks partially passed; full bilingual regression blocked by tab selector issue)

seed_data_creation: None. No new user/question created. Admin session used only for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not retry the same tab selector loop immediately. First align tab testIDs across navigation variants. After fix, validate required matrix: Settings options strictness, TR->EN->TR updates, EN persistence after app reopen, login/register + empty explore + legal texts in both languages, and ensure no undefined/translation-key leaks.
rca_of_issue: Automation failed 3 times around navigation selectors in this run family. Initial failure used a non-existent profile settings selector (open-settings-button) and was corrected. Subsequent blocker was Explore tab targeting: runtime navigation path exposed testID 'tab-kesfet' rather than an expected stable 'tab-explore', causing repeated click/visibility failures and preventing completion of downstream localization checks.
